edition_and_copy_firewall: 28 named digital fascicles are not 28 independent physical manuscript/printed witnesses.

A different institutional catalog prefix is evidence of an additional digitized collection listing, not yet proof of different historical printing plates or an independently legible j45 original leaf.
The secondary 1607 print attribution cannot be silently equated with Xu-An 1599/1600, Sun-Wei 1608 or a separately authenticated Tianjin imprint.
Neither absence of a source entry in root registry nor lack of public PDF byte retrieval proves absence of the physical copy.

No PDF or target folio was accessed through the web tool in this batch; an attempted page/redirect lookup was not a successful download. No PDF screenshot, native crop, pixel SHA or numeric reading may be claimed.
Do not infer that the candidate juan45 is in volume16,17,18,19 from average fascicle position; exact printed fascicle/juan boundary must be read.

The first line cannot automatically be treated as the missing source-original 疾-specific construction for the L35/L132 table-B coefficient, and neither establishes original 少/微 radix/carry.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: A catalog title, fascicle count and candidate 1607 edition-year attribution cannot establish shared plate or lineage to early Xu-An or later Sun-Wei.
A second publicly listed facsimile object cannot be counted as an independent original numeric witness until an exact target folio and copy identity are verified.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Which GBZX0301013346 source volume and digital page contains the second j45 table, L35 and L132, and what do original glyphs and formula text actually show?
What original title-page/colophon/plate evidence independently supports or refutes the 1607 Tianjin print-date attribution and its relation to Xu-An and Sun-Wei?
Does this print provide an authenticated clear L132 original last digit or a source-original 疾-specific coefficient and 少/微 carry instruction?

next_action: First check legitimate free direct GBZX0301013346 PDF bytes/identities, locate exact j45 second-table start and L35/L132 folia before any digit claim, then source-native hash and manual reading; otherwise pursue independently verified Xu-An j45 original and explicit 疾捷法/少微.
